questions.q: What is biological variation defined as?
a: Differences between individuals of the same species
The total number of animals in a habitat

questions.q: Which type of variation is caused solely by differences in surroundings, lifestyle, or diet (such as scarring or language spoken)?
What term describes differences in characteristics between individuals that are inherited from parents through genetic material?
Which process describes the gradual change in species over millions of years through processes like natural selection?
Who was the naturalist who independently proposed the theory of evolution by natural selection alongside Alfred Russel Wallace?

a: Random mutation creates genetic variation within a population

questions.q: Why do many offspring fail to survive in nature according to natural selection theory?
a: Competition for limited resources, predation, and disease create a struggle for survival

questions.q: What happens to individuals within a population that possess advantageous alleles best suited to their environment?
a: They are more likely to survive, reproduce, and pass advantageous alleles to their offspring

questions.q: What is artificial selection (selective breeding)?

The natural extinction of weak species
The random mutation of genes by radiation
The natural adaptation of plants to cold climates

questions.q: Which of the following is a classic example of artificial selection performed by humans over centuries?

Bacterial resistance to antibiotics in hospitals
Peppered moth color shift during the industrial revolution
Darwin's finch beak shapes on Galapagos islands

questions.q: What is a major risk or disadvantage of intensive selective breeding (artificial selection) in agriculture?
a: Crops grow too fast to harvest
Reduced genetic diversity makes populations vulnerable to new diseases or environmental changes

questions.q: What term describes an inherited feature that helps an organism survive and reproduce in its specific habitat?
Which of the following is an example of a structural (anatomical) adaptation in polar bears?
a: Thick layer of blubber and white fur for camouflage in snow

questions.q: Which of the following is an example of a behavioral adaptation in animals?
a: Birds migrating to warmer climates during winter months

questions.q: What is extinction?
a: The rapid birth of new species
The permanent loss of all members of a species from Earth

questions.q: Why is genetic variation within a species crucial for its long-term survival?
a: It provides resilience so that if conditions change, some individuals are likely to possess traits enabling survival

questions.q: Which factor can cause a previously successful species to face rapid extinction?
